chunks.text: What to do.
chunks.say: What to do.
chunks.heard: What to do.

chunks.text: Drink adequate fluids. Aim 200 ml of fluid every hour (one small cup) while awake. Examples of fluids include fruit juice, oral rehydration salts (ORS), coconut water, or soup.
chunks.say: Drink adequate fluids. Aim 200 millilitres of fluid every hour (one small cup) while awake. Examples of fluids include fruit juice, oral rehydration salts (O. R. S.), coconut water, or soup.
chunks.heard: Drink adequate fluids. Aim 200 milliliters of fluid every hour, one small cup, while awake. Examples of fluids include fruit juice, oral rehydration salts, OR size, coconut water, or soup.

chunks.text: Take paracetamol for fever or pain when necessary, but not to exceed 4g per day.
chunks.say: Take paracetamol for fever or pain when necessary, but not to exceed 4 grams per day.
chunks.heard: Take paracetamol for fever or pain when necessary, but not to exceed 4 grams per day.

chunks.text: Get adequate rest.
chunks.say: Get adequate rest.
chunks.heard: Get adequate rest.

chunks.text: Monitor the temperature and dengue warning signs.
chunks.say: Monitor the temperature and dengue warning signs.
chunks.heard: Monitor the temperature and Deng warning signs.

chunks.text: Seek immediate medical care if warning signs develop.
chunks.say: Seek immediate medical care if warning signs develop.
chunks.heard: Seek immediate medical care if warning signs develop.

chunks.text: Attend daily follow-up appointments as advised.
chunks.say: Attend daily follow-up appointments as advised.
chunks.heard: Attend daily follow-up appointments as advised.

chunks.text: Look for mosquito breeding places in and around the home and prevent mosquito bites using mosquito repellent.

chunks.text: What to avoid.
chunks.say: What to avoid.
chunks.heard: What to avoid.

chunks.text: DO NOT take steroids, aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, or any other NSAIDs. If you are already taking these medications, please consult your doctors.

chunks.heard: Do not take steroids, aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, or any other NSAIDS. If you are already taking these medications, please consult your doctors.

chunks.text: DO NOT consume traditional or herbal remedies.

chunks.heard: Do not consume traditional or herbal remedies.

chunks.text: DO NOT take intramuscular injections.

chunks.text: What causes CANCER PAIN?

chunks.text: Cancer pain can result from the tumour pressing on organs, nerves or bones.

chunks.text: The MoH pain scale combines the NRS, VAS, & faces scale. Patients point to their pain level on a scale from 0 to 10.

chunks.text: For children under 7 & cognitively impaired adults, the IASP Faces Pain Scale or FLACC scale may be used. In sedated & intubated patients, pain is assessed through observation including on behaviour.

chunks.text: Will I become addicted to pain medications? Addiction is rare when opioids are used under medical supervision for cancer pain. Your doctor will prescribe them safely to minimise risks.

chunks.heard: Ubat-ubatan termasuk, ubat tahan sakit tanpa preskripsi, contoh, paracetamol, ibuprofen, opioid dengan preskripsi, contoh, morfin, oksikodon, ubat ajufan, contoh, antidepresan atau antikejang untuk sakit saraf.

chunks.text: After a concussion, the patient should be accompanied by a responsible adult if possible.

chunks.text: Go to the nearest Emergency Department for:
chunks.say: Go to the nearest Emergency Department for:
chunks.heard: go to the nearest emergency department for.

chunks.text: loss of consciousness, disorientation, new deafness, imbalance, blurred or double vision, weakness of any limb, excessive sleepiness or drowsiness, vomiting, bleeding from either ear, fitting, or severe headache not relieved by painkillers.
chunks.say: loss of consciousness, disorientation, new deafness, imbalance, blurred or double vision, weakness of any limb, excessive sleepiness or drowsiness, vomiting, bleeding from either ear, fitting, or severe headache not relieved by painkillers.

chunks.text: Do stay within reach of a telephone, rest, sleep regularly, and take painkillers such as paracetamol for headache.
chunks.say: Do stay within reach of a telephone, rest, sleep regularly, and take painkillers such as paracetamol for headache.
chunks.heard: Do stay within reach of a telephone, rest, sleep regularly, and take painkillers, such as paracetamol for headache.

chunks.text: Don't stay at home alone for 48 hours after leaving hospital.
chunks.say: Don't stay at home alone for 48 hours after leaving hospital.
chunks.heard: Don't stay at home alone for 48 hours after leaving hospital.

chunks.text: Don't drink alcohol or take recreational drugs.
chunks.say: Don't drink alcohol or take recreational drugs.
chunks.heard: Don't drink alcohol or take recreational drugs.

chunks.text: Don't take aspirin or sleeping tablets.
chunks.say: Don't take aspirin or sleeping tablets.
chunks.heard: Don't take aspirin or sleeping tablets.

chunks.text: Don't play or train for any contact sport for at least 3 weeks without consulting your doctor.
chunks.say: Don't play or train for any contact sport for at least 3 weeks without consulting your doctor.

chunks.text: Don't drive.
chunks.say: Don't drive.
chunks.heard: Don't drive.

chunks.text: Do: adequate bed rest.
chunks.say: Do: adequate bed rest.
chunks.heard: Do adequate bed rest.

chunks.text: Do: adequate fluid intake (more than 8 glasses or 2 litres for an average person).
chunks.say: Do: adequate fluid intake (more than 8 glasses or 2 litres for an average person).
chunks.heard: Do. Adequate fluid intake. More than 8 glasses or 2 liters for an average person.

chunks.text: Do: take paracetamol (not more than 4 g a day).
chunks.say: Do: take paracetamol (not more than 4 grams a day).
chunks.heard: Do take paracetamol, not more than 4 grams a day.

chunks.text: Do: tepid sponging.
chunks.say: Do: tepid sponging.
chunks.heard: Do tepid sponging.

chunks.text: Do: use mosquito repellent or rest under a mosquito net, even in the daytime.
chunks.say: Do: use mosquito repellent or rest under a mosquito net, even in the daytime.
chunks.heard: Do. Use mosquito repellent or rest under a mosquito net, even in the daytime.

chunks.text: Do: look for and remove mosquito breeding places in and around the home.
chunks.say: Do: look for and remove mosquito breeding places in and around the home.
chunks.heard: Do look for and remove mosquito breeding places in and around the home.

chunks.text: Don't take NSAIDs (painkillers); if already taking them, consult your doctor.
chunks.say: Don't take N. S. A. I. D.s (painkillers); if already taking them, consult your doctor.
chunks.heard: Don't take NSAIDS, painkillers. If already taking them, consult your doctor.

chunks.text: Antibiotics are not required.
chunks.say: Antibiotics are not required.
chunks.heard: Antibiotics are not required.

chunks.text: Don't use massage, cupping or quasa.
chunks.say: Don't use massage, cupping or quasa.
chunks.heard: Don't use massage, cupping, or quassa.

chunks.text: Preventer (budesonide MDI) every day; reliever (salbutamol MDI) when needed.
chunks.say: Preventer (budesonide M. D. I.) every day; reliever (salbutamol M. D. I.) when needed.
chunks.heard: Preventer, Budesonide MDI every day. Reliever, Salbutamol MDI when needed.

chunks.text: Getting worse (waking at night, worse with a cold): reliever every 4 hours, keep taking the preventer, and come to hospital if not better, bringing the MDI and spacer.
chunks.say: Getting worse (waking at night, worse with a cold): reliever every 4 hours, keep taking the preventer, and come to hospital if not better, bringing the M. D. I. and spacer.
chunks.heard: Getting worse, waking at night, worse with a cold, reliever every four hours, keep taking the preventer, and come to hospital, if not better, bringing the MDI and spacer.

chunks.text: Severe (wheeze that does not settle, breathless, hard to talk): come straight to hospital or call an ambulance, taking 4 puffs of the reliever every 4 minutes on the way.
chunks.say: Severe (wheeze that does not settle, breathless, hard to talk): come straight to hospital or call an ambulance, taking 4 puffs of the reliever every 4 minutes on the way.
chunks.heard: severe, he's that does not settle, breathless, hard to talk, come straight to hospital, or call an ambulance, taking four puffs of the reliever every four minutes on the way.

chunks.text: Wash the spacer once a week in soapy water, rinse and let it air dry; do not wipe it with a cloth or tissue or brush the inside.
